display_name: Snapshot file classes and program languages
validation_rules: every regular file of the staged snapshot gets exactly one class, decided in order by the rule table's vendored/generated path globs, exact name, suffix, line-1 shebang, then content sniff (a NUL byte in the first 8 KiB or a known magic number is binary_media), and records that basis
language is set for program:<language> files only; per-class and per-language counts cover every classified file
rows are bounded by max_rows; unlisted rows, unreadable files and skipped links are gaps, and unknown_text files are named in a gap, never dropped
languages_needing_server lists only program languages whose tooling/buildenv-catalog.json image ships a language server
the result validates against its closed schema, content_sha256 binds the census body, and every validate re-derives it from the bound snapshot
classes are file-level facts and untrusted target data, never findings; nothing in the snapshot is executed
